name: Cobalt System Deck
description: A self-contained HTML deck for executive reporting in media and publishing. Its locked cobalt-and-lemon system keeps data, decisions, and exact wording consistent across slides.
whatYouGet: Consistent cobalt-and-lemon layouts with a restrained dot motif
Editable text, labeled charts, and clear decision slides
Source and illustration notes alongside reported figures
goodFit: Editorial strategy updates for client executives
Course business reports with approved metrics
notFor: Brand explorations with multiple competing visual directions
Reports that require invented results to fill gaps

faq.q: Can I provide rough notes instead of a slide outline?
faq.a: Yes. Provide the decision, audience, notes, and evidence. The skill will structure the story and flag facts that need confirmation.

faq.q: Will the deck invent missing performance figures?
faq.a: No. Missing figures are left out or clearly marked as illustrative when a sample is requested.

faq.q: Can I revise the text after delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Headings, body copy, data labels, and notes remain editable HTML text.

demoPrompt: /sl-cobalt-system-deck Create a 9-slide Q4 2025 executive review for fictional Regional Publishing Office, moving from audience evidence and channel performance to editorial priorities and three decisions. Title: “Direct audience growth gives us a clearer next move.” Close: “Approve the test, owners, and review date.” Use the Cobalt Dot System style.
followUpPrompts: Shorten the narrative for a ten-minute executive meeting without changing any figures.
Add source notes to every data slide and flag claims that lack evidence.
Reframe the closing slide around decisions, owners, and dates.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
